primary.name: Deep Navy
primary.usage: Headings, primary CTAs, trust-building areas. Use text-[#1A365D] for all primary H1/H2.

secondary.name: Soft Teal
secondary.usage: Accents, category badges, read-time indicators, hover states.

headings.usage: Highly readable, structured hierarchy for blog posts. Avoid Inter for headings.

body.usage: Clean, legible long-form reading. Use leading-relaxed for body text.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous padding (py-16, py-24) to create a sterile, breathable layout.
layout_and_spacing.cards: Flat solid surfaces with subtle border (border-slate-200), minimal shadow (shadow-sm). No heavy box-shadows. Generous internal padding (p-6).
layout_and_spacing.article_content: Max-width prose (max-w-3xl) for optimal reading line length. Generous line-height.

header.style: Sticky top-0 z-50. Solid white (bg-white) or glass (bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md) with a crisp 1px bottom border (border-slate-200). Must contain Text Logo (Deep Navy), Categories Dropdown, About link, and Search bar.

hero.style: Welcoming, trust-building. Split layout or large feature block. Featured Article highlighted prominently with the `hero_featured` image. Navy text for trust.

article_card.style: Clean white background, border-slate-200, rounded-xl overflow-hidden. Contains image (aspect-video), teal category badge, read time, date, navy title, and muted excerpt.

sidebar.style: Right-hand sidebar. Use sticky positioning for 'About the Medical Editor' or 'Newsletter'. Widget cards should have clear borders (border-slate-200).

footer.style: Deep Navy background (bg-[#1A365D]) with white text. Must contain a prominent medical educational disclaimer, privacy links, and social media links.

buttons.style: Solid Navy (#1A365D) or Teal (#319795), rounded-md or rounded-full, crisp text, subtle hover state.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Multi-page React application containing Home, Article Detail, Category, and About pages.
Use Lucide-React for all icons (search, chevron, clock, etc).
Implement Shadcn UI for standard components: DropdownMenu for Categories, Input for Search, Button for CTAs.
Content must be in Brazilian Portuguese (PT-BR) as requested.
DO NOT build a SaaS landing page layout; structure it strictly as an editorial medical blog with a strong focus on readability.
For the Article Detail page, include an H2/H3 hierarchy and a 'Table of Contents' (Índice).
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (links, buttons, inputs).
Ensure perfect contrast ratios (WCAG AA) especially with the Teal (#319795) and Navy (#1A365D) colors.
Newsletter signup in the sidebar should visually pop but remain sterile (e.g., subtle Teal background or border).
